name: kanban-board
summary: Local, single-user Kanban board SPA. Client-only Vite + React + TypeScript app; boards/columns/cards with drag-and-drop, persisted to browser localStorage. No backend, accounts, or cloud sync.

frontend.state: client-store (Zustand or React context, per spec)

deployment.notes: Client-only single-page app built by Vite to static assets (dist/). No server process, no runtime environment. Runs entirely in the browser.

auth.notes: Single-user, local-only. No accounts, login, sessions, tokens, or authorization of any kind.

dataSensitivity.notes: Only user-authored board/column/card content stored in browser localStorage on the user's own machine. No PII, no credentials, no secrets, no network transmission. No .env files.

criticalityNotes: Personal productivity tool for a single user on their own machine; not business- or safety-critical. Build-proof project (third-party vite-react template init).

network.notes: No network I/O by design; no API calls, no telemetry.

vectors: Free-text card description/labels rendered into the DOM — rely on React JSX escaping, never introduce dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
Corrupt/poisoned localStorage — hydrate via schema-validated try/catch with fallback to a clean default board.

validation.command: bun run build && bun run lint

commands.typecheck: tsc -b --noEmit (not yet defined as a script; covered transitively by build)

validation.notes: spec.md and AGENTS.md declare `bun run smoke:qc` as the quality gate, but package.json defines only dev/build/lint/preview — smoke:qc, typecheck, format, and test/crawl scripts do not exist yet. The runnable validation today is `bun run build` (tsc -b && vite build) and `bun run lint` (oxlint). See remediation-quality-gate-scripts.

conventions.format: prettier configured (.prettierrc: tabs, 100 cols, single quotes) but not installed / no format script
conventions.notes: AGENTS.md mandates spernakit-like conventions (named exports, no `any`, tabs+semicolons), but the current starter (src/App.tsx, main.tsx) is stock Vite and does not yet conform. tsconfig does not enable strict mode. Vestigial spernakit eslint/prettier config drift present (root + empty frontend/).

status.notes: Pristine vite-react third-party scaffold; none of the 8 spec backlog features implemented yet. Build and lint pass on the starter.
